decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. Utilizing a mix of powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Evolved Sleeper, along with disruption spells like Go for the Throat and Make Disappear, this deck is able to control the board while dealing significant damage to the opponent. Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional value and control options, while Faerie Mastermind and Kaito Shizuki offer additional support and card advantage. The deck aims to finish the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.
